card.name: Final digit of a number
card.fires_on: A single digit that completes a multi-digit number or decimal, such as the 2 in 12, the 4 in 14, or the 9 in 58.9. It fires in dates, dose and duration ranges, and measurements.

modes.label: Duration or dose ranges
modes.description: Last digit of a number in a table of days or doses, often after 'to' or a dash.
modes.example: Community Acquired Pneumonia ( 1.1 ) 400 mg 7 to 1<<4>> Uncomplicated Skin and Skin Structure In

modes.label: Dates and general figures
modes.description: Last digit of a day or year, or of a decimal value, in ordinary text.
modes.example: Abraham Lincoln was born in a log cabin in Kentucky on February 1<<2>>, 1809. This

card.plain: It marks the last digit of a number that is still being written out, such as 14 days or 12 July.
